summary: Settings > Devices & machines lists paired devices with search, sort, Online now and Earlier groups, a fold for devices not seen in 30 days, per-device Details (last seen, address, system, app, install id, paired date) and Revoke (one device, or every inactive one after a confirm that lists them). A device can be renamed on the desktop; the name is stored on its backend session and replaces the reported name. The desktop endpoint no longer accepts the old shared pairing token: the stored value is deleted and a phone that still uses it is closed with 4001. The filled destructive button uses #da3633 app-wide.

updateRelease.reason: Desktop release only. customName is an optional field on the device session JSON, so rows written before stay valid and an older desktop ignores it. Deleting mobilePairing.token is one-way by design: one user, no transition period, and a phone on it pairs again with a QR.

automated: tests/unit/device-list.test.ts: groups, search on name, model and platform, the 30-day fold, sort, relative and absolute dates.
tests/unit/device-rename.test.ts: rename, clear, length bound, a re-reported identity keeps the custom name, and a phone session cannot call mobile-pairing:rename.

tests/unit/mobile-legacy-token-retired.test.ts: through the real MobileEndpoint, the stored token is deleted on apply, a ?token= dial is closed with 4001, and a token alone does not start the endpoint. All three fail on the old endpoint.
tests/unit/destructive-fill-contrast.test.ts: white on the destructive fill reads at 4.5:1 or better.
Visual screens settings-devices and settings-devices-details in Dark and Light; confirm-dialog baselines refreshed for the new destructive fill.

Phones: only the refusal path applies and needs no code change. A phone still on the shared token is closed with 4001, which apps/mobile/src/stores/connections.ts and the Android OkHttpWebSocketDialer already show as "This computer removed this phone. Pair again." The rename is desktop only and never reaches a phone.
notExercised: No physical phone run of the 4001 path for a phone on the shared token; both phones already map any 4001 to the removed copy, which the device-revoke work verified.
